experimental_boundary.reaction_energy_convention: Products minus separated reactants; negative means exoergic. This is an experimental translational-energy-derived channel boundary, not a computed candidate energy or a branching ratio.
experimental_boundary.source: Published crossed-beam measurement, main article PDF page 4, Fig. 3a discussion.

reaction_energy_definition: DeltaE0 = E0(product) + E0(H atom, neutral doublet) - E0(SiN, neutral doublet) - E0(isoprene, neutral singlet); E0 is electronic energy plus ZPE at 0 K; use the same method and zero for all components. Negative values mean exoergic.
